title: 17036 - 17036/P0652/001618
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Intake Manifold Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G31) faulty
Intake Manifold Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G31) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Intake Manifold Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G31)
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Intake Manifold Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G31)
technicalNotes:
When found in 1.9l TDI (BEW):
Kontrol edin:  Atmospheric Pressure (MVB 010.2) and Intake Manifold Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleri (MVB 010.3). Compare both Values with Engine OFF, the Tolerance should be +/- 50 mbar.
Kontrol edin:  Variable Nozzle Turbocharger (VNT). Specifically, check the electronic actuator position sensor G500 , including unplugging it for testing.
When found in other engines:
Kontrol edin:  the factory repair manual since this fault can point to problems with several different sensors.
Specifically in the BLB engine, faulty MAF wiring can trigger it.
